name: Mildew
overview: Scripture reveals mildew as a form of divine judgment used by the LORD to discipline His people when they turn away from Him. In Deuteronomy 28:22, mildew is listed among severe afflictions that will come upon those who disobey God. Similarly, Amos 4:9 and Haggai 2:17 describe mildew alongside blasting and other calamities that affect the fruitfulness of the land and the labor of the people, emphasizing that these judgments occur despite God's call to repentance. These passages underscore God's holiness and justice, showing that physical consequences like mildew serve as warnings to return to faithful obedience.
